provenance.reconstruction: FITTED-COEFFICIENT RECONSTRUCTION, NOT FRAMES. E-GSC6 rows are its committed per-arm additive fit (own residual 0.70 deg training / 0.71-0.75 deg held-out); E-GSC7 rows are its committed shared-effect steps at 5766 MHz ONLY. Every holdout number is optimistic by roughly the additive fit's own residual.
provenance.DEPLOYMENT_STATUS: NOT DEPLOYABLE -- see the report, including its 2026-08-13 addendum. Two reasons, either sufficient: (1) this is a single-radio fit with no leave-one-radio-out and no leave-one-epoch-out evidence, and the pooled two-radio fit is worse than applying no correction (7.347 deg LOFO vs a 7.323 deg anchor-only baseline); (2) the rover corpus has no usable equal-gain anchor, which this model is defined as a residual to. NOT a reason any more: carrier transfer. E-GSC8 measured 5766 -> 5840 MHz at 0.451 deg RMS on the clean radio (95% CI 0.329-0.554), and the damaged radio's 2.842 deg is 98% a constant -2.819 deg offset that cancels in this model's D = H(s1) - H(s2) form.
provenance.fit_value_reproduction: Fitted values are the 2026-08-12 published ones, unchanged. Re-emitting on a different BLAS/thread configuration reproduces them only to ~1e-7 deg, not byte-for-byte; two consecutive re-emits in one environment ARE byte-identical, so the drift is environment-sensitivity in the least-squares solve, not run-to-run nondeterminism. The input_sha256 for the E-GSC7 analysis.json changed at 4292c01 because E-GSC8 rewrote two artifact PATH STRINGS in it; every numeric leaf in that file is unchanged, verified leaf-by-leaf.
